lastText: GQGCOMPTE RENDUHome19141915191619171918HARD MODE — EROSION 4/6-8MANPOWER-7MUNITIONS+8ARMY MORALEIV.1918Two RetreatsEach army withdrew toward what it could not afford to lose. The British went toward their ports and the French toward their capital, and the gap between them widened with every mile because both were behaving correctly by their own lights. Neither army was beaten. The space between them was.Speculative counterfactualSpeculative. Unified command was conceded historically, in this month, under exactly this pressure. It is the counterfactual precisely because everyone involved could see what refusing it would cost.Return to file
